newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia c.bank injects 65.9 mln kuna repo funds.
newsitem.headline: Croatia c.bank injects 65.9 mln kuna repo funds.

text.p: Croatia's central bank said it injected 65.9 million kuna ($10.3 million) into the banking system on Friday through a repo deal.
It bought from six commercial banks' outstanding liquidity and treasury bills nominally worth 67 million kuna.
The deal expires on July 22. The bills will be due for repurchase at a weighted rate of 7.55 percent, the bank said. -- Laura Lui, Zagreb newsroom +385 1 455 7075 ($ = 6.374 Croatian Kuna)
